what: Deposits read in full in-session, before the parallel sweep, and the shapes found in each. These eight readings calibrated the protocol (the seven shapes and the exclusions came from them) and serve as the calibration batch: a parallel reader re-reads them blind and its finds are compared with these.

reader.how: each text printed in full and read from first line to last; no search substituted for reading
